mapper.select: select imsg_id, imsg_session_id, imsg_sender_id, imsg_type, imsg_content, imsg_attachment_url, imsg_is_recalled, imsg_created_at from t_im_message where imsg_session_id = #{sessionId} and imsg_is_recalled = 0 order by imsg_created_at asc, imsg_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into t_im_message (imsg_session_id, imsg_sender_id, imsg_type, imsg_content, imsg_attachment_url, imsg_created_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{attachmentUrl}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, category, content from t_im_quick_reply order by id
mapper.update: update t_im_quick_reply set category = #{category}, content = #{content} where id = #{id}
